# OmniDB Documentation

## Overview

OmniDB is an open source browser-based app designed to access and manage many different Database Management systems, e.g. PostgreSQL, Oracle and MySQL. OmniDB can run either as an App or via Browser, combining the flexibility needed for various access paths with a design that puts security first.

---

## 1. Introduction

URL: https://www.omnidb.net/en/docs/01_introduction.html

**Description:** Introduction to OmniDB - a browser-based database management tool supporting PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, and more. Features a unified workspace, background execution of queries and procedures across multiple databases, and encrypted data storage.

**Key Topics:**
- History and origins of OmniDB
- Multi-DBMS support
- Security features
- 2025-2026 revival; backend fully rewritten from Python/Django to Go in 3.6.x
